instruction: A chemist mixes 30 kg of a 10% salt solution with 20 kg of a 25% salt solution. What is the salt percentage of the resulting mixture? Compute it with the bash tool (python3 -c). Work only inside the current directory. When you are done, write ONLY the final answer to the file answer.txt in the current directory (for example with bash: echo 42 > answer.txt).
